strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Bands SMA 20-2
strategy_roster.notes: The documented lower-band upside cross enters; the opposite upper-band cross exits. The 20-period, 2-standard-deviation bands are exact and no stop is specified.

strategy_roster.name: Gold Pullback
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,14) > ema(close,60) and low <= ema(close,21) and ema(close,21) <= high and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and roc(close,21) > 0 and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: EMA pullback, EMA trend, MACD direction, and RSI confirmation are retained; MACD uses 12/26/9 because its periods are undocumented. Positive 21-bar ROC approximates the unsupported bullish TDI filter. Candle-relative symmetric SL/TP cannot be expressed, so trend and MACD reversals exit.

strategy_roster.name: EMA Prediction
strategy_roster.notes: The 1/2 EMA prediction crossover is combined with the documented bullish/bearish candle confirmation, and the bearish reversal exits. Tick-based 1000/2000 SL/TP are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: S7 Up Bot
strategy_roster.entry_long: low < donchian_low_prev(low,2) + 0.01 * close and low > donchian_low_prev(low,2) - 0.01 * close and close > low
strategy_roster.notes: The long side requires near-equal current/prior lows followed by a positive span from the low. Prior-low access uses a 2-bar prior Donchian, a normalized 1% difference proxies the undocumented HL Divergence, and positive close-minus-low retains the Span Price sign; the documented minimum span distance is unavailable. A cross below the prior low proxies Exit At Extremum; absolute TP/SL/trailing values are unspecified.

strategy_roster.name: MFI Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: MFI is unsupported, so RSI(14) is the price-only proxy for crosses above 60 and below 40; the volume component is not reproduced. Opposite crossing exits. Documented 1000/2000 tick SL/TP are not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: SpectrAnalysis WPR
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R and spectral analysis are unavailable; a rising or falling RSI(13) turn is the closest bounded-oscillator proxy. The documented upward and downward turns enter and exit, respectively.

strategy_roster.name: Trend RDS
strategy_roster.notes: Prior-two-bar Donchian extremes approximate three higher lows, while the negated lower-high condition enforces the dual-pattern block. The mirrored lower-high structure exits. The 09:00-12:00 gate, pip stops, trailing logic, and risk sizing are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Gap DM
strategy_roster.notes: On daily bars, the prior bar's close is the previous-session proxy; a gap-down open enters contrarian long and filling back above it exits. The 1-pip minimum, exact session boundary, position cap, and disabled pip SL/TP are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Doji Trader
strategy_roster.entry_long: close - open <= 0.1 * atr(high,low,close,14) and open - close <= 0.1 * atr(high,low,close,14) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,2) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: A body within 0.1 ATR(14) approximates a doji, and a close above the prior two-bar high approximates the delayed range breakout. Stateful doji-range arming, the three-bar search, session clock, and step-based SL/TP are unsupported; a cross below the recent low proxies range failure.

strategy_roster.name: DoubleUp2 Martingale
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(13,33,2) is exact; a close z-score above 2.3 approximates CCI(8) exceeding +230. Positive one-bar ROC proxies favorable movement toward the fixed 120-point partial-profit exit. CCI itself, exact point distance, and martingale/equity sizing are unsupported.
